name: Ogmo-Editor-3/OgmoEditor3-CE
description: OGMO Editor 3 Community Edition is an open-source, project-oriented 2D level editor made for indie game developers, supporting tile layers, entity layers, and JSON level export.
score_rationale: 573 stars, a well-regarded free level editor in the indie community with good multi-layer support, though modest adoption compared to Tiled and LDtk.
summary: Project-oriented 2D level editor with tile and entity layer support
